title: Reissner–Nordström gravitational quasinormal-mode dataset

conventions.imaginary_part: Signed Im(omega), negative for damped modes. Positive plot damping is -omega_im.
conventions.hat_n: Inherited family index, not a sorting by instantaneous damping.
conventions.excitation: B = mathscr{B} = B_ref/(2 omega d_omega B_inc), in the axial master-field normalization.
conventions.sheet: Frequency real-part sign alone does not determine the Riemann sheet.

storage.precision: Read CSV numeric fields as strings/Decimal to preserve stored digits.

precision_origin.stored_decimal_string: Frequency or complex-excitation components restored from stored decimal strings. Charge keeps its saved representation. This is a storage label, not a certified accuracy.
precision_origin.plot_numeric_value: Saved plotting value, with no invented extra digits.

storage.matching: Restore decimal values only when family, charge and both complex components match the final plot input exactly after binary64 conversion; no nearest-root matching.
storage.ordering: ell,hat_n,Q,plot_order; sample_order is the resulting within-family order.
storage.duplicates: Every final plot-input row is retained, including equal-charge evaluations.

source_kind.own_method: Own-method point in the final figure selector
source_kind.comparison: Continued-fraction comparison point retained in the saved plot; not a new accuracy certification.

storage.source_record: JSON pointer, one-based CSV row including the header, or one-based JSONL line. For raw_omega_decimal pointers, Q is in the sibling raw_Q_decimal array.
storage.missing: Blank diagnostics mean not supplied. Blank hat_n for additional strict-extremal roots means parent unassigned.

spectrum.csv.description: All 68,167 final spectrum samples; Q=1 results are in families.csv and extremal_unconventional.csv.

families.csv.description: 84 family limits: 75 directly computed finite-damping Q=1 roots and 9 zero-frequency limits.
families.csv.endpoint_kind: finite_damping_QNM or zero_frequency_limit. Zero values for the latter are limits, not isolated Q=1 roots.
families.csv.max_check_amplitude: Saved maximum incoming-amplitude magnitude in strict-root checks.
families.csv.max_setting_shift: Saved frequency variation across strict-root check settings.
families.csv.working_digits: Arithmetic precision, not certified significant figures.

near_extremal.csv.description: 75 latest finite-damping samples and 76 accepted zero-frequency-family samples.
near_extremal.csv.zero_frequency: Frequencies taken from runs[0].omega in origin_final.json.
near_extremal.csv.distance_to_extremal: Recalculated with Decimal precision 100 from stored frequencies; a distance to a different-charge root, not a frequency error.

extremal_unconventional.csv.description: Two Q=1 roots classified by continuation contour. No Schwarzschild parent is assigned.
extremal_unconventional.csv.max_incoming_amplitude_on_sheet: Maximum incoming amplitude on the upper contour.

excitation.csv.description: 744 samples from four resonant-pair windows plus 76 zero-frequency-family samples.
excitation.csv.B_abs_origin: stored_value or derived_from_components; the latter is Decimal arithmetic, not a new solve.
excitation.csv.window: E, P, A, D or zero_frequency; intervals in inventory.json.

sources.json.description: Input paths, SHA-256 hashes and archive-member locations.

inventory.json.description: Row counts, precision coverage and resonance windows.

validation.json.description: Completed export checks, not new numerical error certification.

diagnostics: Working digits, amplitude residuals, settings changes and extremal-root distances are distinct quantities.
reproduction: scripts/export_dataset.py and scripts/validate_dataset.py require the original project and Code/numerical_history.zip. CSV files can be read independently.
unchanged: Original research files and manuscript LaTeX/PDF are unchanged.
